prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen, right-click for the quick command wheel, or press Alt+P to summon or hide them anytime.", "Launch Desktop Companion", "Quick Controls Ready", "Desktop Hotkey Overview"]
1: ["Choose Your Pet's Voice & Sounds", "Listen to sound samples to select your desktop pet's audio reactions.", "Save Sound Profile", "Play Sample Bark & Purr", "Sound Profile Selection"]
2: ["Check your desktop system tray if the pet window does not open automatically within 5 seconds.", "Tray Diagnostics OK"]
3: ["Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pets", "Signing in ensures your adopted desktop pets, items, and settings are safely backed up to the cloud and restored across devices.", "Continue with Account", "Cloud Pet Auto-Restore Enabled", "Safe Sign-In"]
4: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet to open quick actions. Double-click to talk or change outfits. Press Ctrl+Shift+P to hide or show.", "You can change interaction shortcuts anytime in app settings.", "Start Playing Now"]
5: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Experience", "Pick pre-made companions for instant desktop play or create a custom pet from your own photos.", "Confirm Choice", "Instant Adopt vs Custom Pet Creation"]
6: ["Custom Photo Alignment Check", "Review photo lighting and face outline alignment before generating custom pet graphics.", "Proceed to Certificate", "Lighting & Face Outline Diagnostics"]
7: ["Customize Pet Personality & Traits", "Select core behavioral traits like playful, calm, or chatty before finalizing adoption.", "Next: Adopt Pet", "Personality Traits Selector", "Official Adoption & Personality Deed", "Your companion's personality profile has been attached to their official desktop adoption papers."]
8: ["Already have an account? Sign in now to automatically restore your existing pet profile and inventory.", "Account Pet Recovery Active"]
9: ["Claim Your Welcome Pet Toy & Finish Setup!", "Complete setup now to unlock the interactive laser pointer pet toy right on your desktop dock.", "Claim Toy & Finish", "Free Starter Accessory Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and gifts ("Free Starter Accessory Unlocked", "Claim Your Welcome Pet Toy") to incentivize setup completion.
